exposure: unplanned out-of-hospital delivery (home or car) vs. in-hospital delivery
cohort: Women who underwent unplanned out-of-hospital deliveries (n = 90) vs. in-hospital deliveries (n = 180) between 2004 and 2014, matched for gestational age and parity
finding: While unplanned out-of-hospital deliveries were associated with higher rates of neonatal polycythemia and hypothermia, women with unplanned out-of-hospital deliveries tended to have fewer cesarean and operative deliveries in their obstetrical history.
mod_finding: Women with unplanned out-of-hospital deliveries had significantly fewer cesarean deliveries and operative deliveries in their obstetrical history compared to women with in-hospital deliveries.
gest_age: Women were matched based on gestational age
